title: Customer Management and Analysis (2016)
subtitle: MongoDB, Express, AngularJS, NodeJS, Bootstrap, AWS, SDB
text:
Created a customer service and marketing web application.
  • Flags potential customer issues
  • Flags renewals and tracks contacts
  • Charts customer usage with graphs
  • Analyses trails
  • Stores quotes, company messages, internal school notes and renewal notes

featured.description: Designed and developed an application used to analyze customer usage, manage subscriptions and target problem areas
